SGLang PR #29927 head included in the source patch.
Current SGLang PR #33614 head: synchronize DSpark sampling, verify-budget, and graph-capture decisions across TP ranks.
SGLang PR #32194 head included in the source patch.
SGLang PR #30700 head included in the source patch.

SGLang PR #32815 head included in the source patch.
Current SGLang PR #33518 head (sglext_spec: per-request speculative statistics on the OpenAI endpoints).
The unique #33518 implementation commit replayed from its current head; the head also contains an upstream-main merge.
SGLang PR #33568: match DSV4/DSV32 tool prompts to the reference encoding.

Current-main replay of the local SGLang consumer for FlashInfer PR #4393.
Local performance fix: on SM120, use FlashInfer mHC only at the validated 1024-token prefill threshold so decode retains the faster small-M path.

patches.description: Open SGLang PRs #29927, #33614, #32194, #30700, #32330, #32686, #32815, #33518, #33568, #33732, #33805 and #34139 plus the remaining local all-reduce and FlashInfer-mHC dispatch fixes. Merged #33616 and #34189 are supplied by main; #34189 replaces the former #32183 carry.
Open FlashInfer PRs #4308 and #4393. Merged #4315, #4329 and #4380 are supplied by main and are not carried; #4380 replaced the former #4309 carry.

verification.note: Applying the SGLang patch to DSV4_0731_SGLANG_MAIN_HEAD yields DSV4_0731_SGLANG_EFFECTIVE_TREE. Applying the FlashInfer patch to DSV4_0731_FLASHINFER_MAIN_HEAD yields DSV4_0731_FLASHINFER_EFFECTIVE_TREE.
